en: Even the very gods cannot obtain victory over him who is protected with the strength of my arms. I will (tomorrow) form such an array which Partha will never be able to reach the end of.

sa: द्रोणस्य मिषतश्चाहं सगणस्य विलप्यतः। मूर्धानं सिन्धुराजस्य पातयिष्यामि भूतले॥
en: Before the eyes of Drona and before his bewailing followers, I will fell down on earth the head of the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: मा शोकं दिष्ट्या महारथो धीरः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः। क्षात्रेण विधिना प्राप्तो वीराभिलषितां गतिम्॥
en: Indeed it is through good fortune that mighty car-warrior, modest and equal to his father in prowess, has obtained the goal coveted by the heroes, in consequence of his observance of Kshatriya duties.

sa: व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुरनिवर्ती स्थप्रणुत्। गतस्तव वरारोहे पुत्रः स्वर्ग ज्वरं जहि॥
en: Of expansive chest and mighty arms, unretreating and slayer of car-warriors, your son, 0 you of dainty waist, has gone to heaven. Renounce yours fever of grief.

sa: नूनं गतिः कृतान्तस्य प्राज्ञैरपि सुदुर्विदा। यत्र तत्वं केशवे नाथे संग्रामेऽनाथवद्धतः॥
en: Surely the ways of the Destroyer are mysterious even to the wise, inasmuch as, you, having Keshava himself for your protector, have been slain in battle like one perfectly helpless.

sa: गोसहस्रप्रदातॄणां क्रतुदानां च या गतिः। नैवेशिकं चाभिमतं ददतां या गति: शुभा।॥
en: That blessed end which they attain who give away a thousand cows or who perform charitable deeds at a sacrifice or who give away houses and palaces to the liking of the recipients.

sa: ततः प्रणिहितो ब्राह्ये मुहूर्ते शुभलक्षणे। आत्मानमर्जुनोऽपश्यद् गगने सहकेशवम्॥
en: Thus rapt up in meditation, Arjuna saw himself and Keshava roving in the skies, just when the hour Brahma of auspicious indication set in.

sa: नयनानां सहस्रश्च विचित्राङ्गं महौजसम्। पार्वत्या सहितं देवं भूतसंधैश्च भास्वरैः॥
en: He was the highly puissant god having his body rendered beautiful with a thousand eyes; and in company with Parvati and numerous other beings of great effulgence.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच श्वोभूते किमकार्पुस्ते दुःखशोकसमन्विताः। अभिमन्यौ हते तत्र के वायुध्यन्त मामकाः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When the day after the one in which Abhimanyu had been slain, came, what did the Pandavas, afflicted with grief and sorrow, do? What warriors of my host fought with them?

sa: वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन पुत्र संशाम्य पाण्डवैः। कालप्राप्तमहं मन्ये मा त्वं दुर्योधनातिगाः॥
en: Me seems the time for concluding peace has arrived. O Duryodhana, do not violate my command. If you now disregard the son of Vasudeva who now entreats you for peace.

sa: गतोदके सेतुबन्धो याक् तागयं तव। विलापो निष्फलो राजन् मा शुचो भरतर्षभ॥
en: O king, these lamentations of yours are as useless as the construction of embankments when the waters have receeded from a flooded field. O foremost of the Bharatas, do not indulge in grief.

sa: सिद्धचारणसंघानां विस्मयः सुमहानभूत्। द्रोणेन विहितं दृष्ट्वा व्यूहं क्षुब्धार्णवोपमम्॥
en: Beholding that array formed by Drona that resembled the ocean agitated (by the tempest), the Siddhas and the Charanas were filled with great wonder.

sa: सशैलसागरवनां नानाजनपदाकुलाम्। ग्रसेद् व्यूहः क्षितिं सर्वामिति भूतानि मेनिरे॥
en: The creatures then thought that array would devour the whole Earth with her mountains, oceans, forests and the various rivers flowing on its surface.

sa: नृत्यतो रथमार्गेषु धनुर्व्यायच्छतस्तथा। न कश्चित् तत्र पार्थस्य ददृशोऽन्तरमण्वपि॥
en: Not the slightest flew was then detected in Pritha's son, as he danced in the terrace of his chariot and stretched his mighty bow.

sa: आवर्तमानमावृत्तं युध्यमानं च पाण्डवः। प्रमुखे तिष्ठमानं च न किंचिन्न निहन्ति सः॥
en: There was none among the hostile troop, whether standing in front of him or exerting in battle or moving about or urged on, whom the arrows discharged by Arjuna did not pierce through.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा पततस्तूर्णमङ्कुशैरभिचोदितान्। व्यालम्बहस्तान् संरब्धान् सपक्षानिव पर्वतान्॥
en: Beholding those infuriate and huge elephants with extended trunks and urged with hooks make towards himself like so many winged mountains.

sa: तेषां संयच्छता संख्ये परस्परमजिह्मगैः। अर्जुनो ध्वजिनीं राजन्नभीक्ष्णं समकम्पयत्॥
en: Thus when they fought on, piercing one another in battle with straight coursing arrows, Arjuna, O king, made the hostile army tremble before him.

sa: हाहाकारो महांस्तत्र सैन्यानां समजायत। स्वेनास्त्रेण हतं दृष्ट्वा श्रुतायुधमरिंदमम्॥
en: The troops began to utter loud wails of woe, for indeed they had seen that subduer of foes Shrutayusha slain by his own weapon.

sa: प्रतिजग्राह तां कृष्णाः पीनेनांसेन वीर्यवान्। नाकम्पयत शौरि सा विन्ध्यं गिरिमिवानिलः॥
en: The highly puissant Krishna received those strokes on his broad and well-developed shoulders; and that mace could not cause Shauri to tremble even as a tempest cannot shake a mountain.

sa: प्रत्युद्यान्ती तमेवैषा कृत्येव दुरधिष्ठिता। जघान चास्थितं वीरं श्रुतायुधममर्षणम्॥
en: Like some ill-accomplished feat of conjuration injuring the conjurer the mace turning to Shrutayusha, smote that heroic and enraged monarch stationed in his car.

sa: विप्रद्रुतेष्वनीकेषु विध्वस्तेषु समन्ततः। प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्ते द्रोणमभ्ययात्॥
en: When the divisions of your army had been broken and routed in all directions, your son seeing his troops shattered speedily proceeded towards Drona.

sa: नादास्यच्चेद् वरं मह्यं भवान् पाण्डवनिग्रहे। नाचारयिष्यं गच्छन्तमहं सिन्धुपतिं गृहान्॥
en: If you had not given me assurances of vanquishing the Pandavas, I would never have prevented the ruler of the Sindhus from returning to his own dominions.

sa: युधिष्ठिरश्च मे ग्राह्यो मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्। एवं मया प्रतिज्ञातं क्षत्रमध्ये महाभुज॥
en: Yudhishthira also should be captured by myself, before they eyes of all bowmen. Even this, O mighty armed one, has been the vow undertaken by me amidst all Kshatriya warriors.

sa: देवा ऊचुः प्रमर्दितानां वृत्रेण देवानां देवसत्तम। गतिर्भव सुरश्रेष्ठ त्राहि नो महतो भयात्॥
en: The celestials said O foremost of the celestials, O best of the gods, be you the protector of the gods now, crushed as they are by the Asura Vritra. Save us from this our great fear.

sa: धृष्टाद्युम्नमुखाः पार्था व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः। द्रोणस्य सैन्यं ते सर्वे शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: The troops of the sons of Pritha commanded by Dhristadyumna, all accomplished in smiting and arranged in proper order, covered the division of Drona with arrowy showers.

sa: तेऽपि सर्वप्रयत्नेन द्रोणमेव समाद्रवन्। बिभित्सन्तो महासेतुं वार्योधाः प्रबला इव॥
en: They also, putting forth all their endeavours, awaited Drona himself, like a strong current of water striking against an embankment with a view of carry it away.

sa: स्तीर्थानि रम्याणि तपोवनानि। महान्ति चान्यानि सरांसि पार्थाः सम्पश्यमानाः प्रययुनरावयाः॥
en: Similarly advised by Arshtishena those foremost of men, the Parthas, proceeded along, beholding (on the way) various great and beautiful Tirthas (sacred places resorted to by pilgrims).

sa: हन्यतां दुर्मतिर्भीष्मः पशुवत् साध्वयं नृपाः। सर्वैः समेत्य संरब्धैर्दह्यता वा कटाग्निना॥
en: Therefore, O kings, let this wicked minded Bhishma be killed like an animal, or let us master all together, and let him be burnt in a fire made of straw".

sa: वनानि रम्याणि नद्यो सरांसि गुहा गिरीणां गिरिगह्वराणि। दिवानिशं प्राप्य नरर्षभाणाम्॥
en: (And as they journeyed on), romantic forests, rivers, lakes, caves of mountain, mighty mountain, caverns-all these always, by day and night became the dwelling places of those most excellent men.

sa: श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवन् स्त्रीणां माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्। कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र सूक्ष्मं धर्म्यं च तत्त्वतः॥
en: O you that are possessed of great energy, I desire to listen to the best account of a woman's greatness, O Brahmanas, you relate to me in detail the principles of pure morality.

sa: अक्षयश्च भवेत् स्वर्गस्त्वत्प्रसादाद्धि नः प्रभो। त्वां पुत्रं चाप्यभीप्सामः कृत्वैतदनृणो भव॥
en: We desire to adopt you as our son, so that, O lord, everlasting bliss might be secured to us through your favour. Repay thus the obligation you owe to us.

sa: यमस्तु राजाधर्मज्ञः सर्वप्राणभृतां प्रभुः। प्रेतसत्त्वगतिं ह्येनां दक्षिणामाश्रितो दिशम्॥
en: And that righteous king Yama, the lord of all living creatures, presides over yonder southern point, the path of the spirits of the departed.

sa: राजा विदर्भाधिपति: पिता मम महारथः। भीमो नाम क्षितिपतिश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता॥
en: The royal Bhima, the ruler of the Vidharbhas, the great warrior, the lord of the Earth and the protector of the four different orders, is my sire.

sa: सिन्धोश्च प्रभवं गत्वा सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम्। तत्रोष्य रजनीः पञ्च विन्देद् बहुसुवर्णकम्॥
en: Going to Sindhu which is frequented by the Siddhas and the Gandharvas and living there for five nights, one obtains the fruits of giving away much gold.

sa: द्यूतप्रियश्च कौन्तेयो न च जानाति देवितुम्। आहूतश्चैष्यति व्यक्तं द्यूतादपि रणादपि॥
en: The son of Kunti (Yudhishthira) is also fond of the play, although he possesses little skill in it. He is sure to come, if challenged to pay or to fight.

sa: ततो महेन्द्रमासाद्य जामदग्न्यनिषेवितम्॥ रामतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्।
en: Then going to Mahendra, frequented by the son of Jamadagni and bathing at the Rama Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तान् सर्वानुत्सुकान् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवान् दीनचेतसः। आश्वासयंस्तथाधौम्यो बृहस्पतिसमोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Seeing all the Pandavas afflicted with anxiety and depressed in spirits, Dhaumya who was like Brihaspati himself, thus comforted them and spoke to them.

sa: सर्वज्ञः सर्वभावज्ञः सर्वशत्रुभयंकरः। इति स्म भाषते काव्यो जम्भत्यागे महासुरान्॥
en: The omniscient, the knower of all creatures' thoughts, the terror to all foes, Kavya, thus spoke to the great Asuras (to induce them) to abandon Jambha (Asura).

sa: दमी चात्र नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुतः। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र हयमेधमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: O foremost of men, it was here that Drimi was worshipped by all the celestials. Bathing here one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice).

sa: तत्र गत्वार्जुनो दण्डमाजहारामितं धनम्। इदं चाद्भुतमत्रासीत् तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: Arjuna, however, went there and exacted as tribute a vast quantity of wealth. There happened another wonderful incident, which I shall describe to you. Listen to it.

sa: त्वमेव शक्तस्तां लङ्कां सयोधां सहवाहनाम्। स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य विनाशयितुमञ्जसा॥
en: Depending on your own strength of arms, you were capable of instantly destroying Lanka, with its warriors, heroes, elephants and chariots.

sa: अथान्तरिक्षाच्छुश्राव वाचं गम्भीर निःस्वनाम्। राजन् मा साहसं कार्षीः पुत्रान् न त्यक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: But he heard a voice in the sky uttered in a grave and solcinn voice; it said "O king, do not be guilty of this hasty acts. You should not abandon your sons.

sa: समुच्छ्रितमहाकायो द्वितीय इव पर्वतः। ताम्रक्षणस्तीक्ष्णंष्ट्रो भृकुटीकुटिलाननः॥ दीर्घलाङ्गलमाविध्य दिशो व्याप्य स्थितः कपिः। तद् रूपं महदालक्ष्य भ्रातुः कौरवनन्दनः॥
en: Having attained to a lofty and gigantic body which looked like another mountain, (a body) furnished with coppery eyes and sharp teeth and a face marked by frowns, he lay covering all sides, lashing his long tail. That descendant of Kuru (Bhima), seeing his brother's that gigantic form.

sa: अमर्षजो हि संतापः पावकाद् दीप्तिमत्तरः। येनाहमभिसंतप्तो न नक्तं न दिवा शये॥
en: The pain that one feels in suppressing his anger is more burning than fire itself. I burn with it even now and I cannot sleep either in the night or in the day.

sa: ते तं ममर्दुः सहसा चेष्टमानं महीतले। हाहाकारं प्रमुञ्चन्तः सार्थिकाः शरणार्थिनः॥ ते वनगुल्मांश्चधावन्तो निद्राधा बहवोऽभवन्। केचिद् दन्तैः करैः केचित् केचित् पद्भ्यां हता गजैः।।
en: The elephants, all on a sudden, crushed the caravan, which was sleeping in the ground. Then the merchants, uttering the cries of Ah! and Alas! sought for protection. Blinded by sleep, they all rushed towards the bushes and the forest (for protection). But some of them were killed by the tusks of those elephants and some by trunks, as also some were killed by their legs.

sa: यच्च ते मत्परिज्ञाने कौतूहलमरिंदम। अनर्थकेषु को भावः पुरुषस्य विजानतः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, as regards your curiosity to know me, I tell you this, why should a wise man be eager to learn a superfluous thing?

sa: कदलीमृगमोकानि कृष्णश्यामारुणानि च। काम्बोजः प्राहिणोत् तस्मै परार्ध्यानपि कम्बलान्। गजयोषिद्गवाश्वस्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ त्रिशतं चोष्ट्रवामीनां शतानि विचरन्त्युत। राजन्या बलिमादाय समेता हि नृपक्षये॥
en: The king of Kamboja sent to him hundreds and thousands of black darkish and red skins of the deer called Kadali, and also blankets of excellent texture. Hundreds and hundreds and thousands and thousands of female elephants, horses and cows and thirty thousand female camels wander (within his palace); the kings brought them all as tribute when they assembled there.

sa: अथ चम्पां समासाद्य भागीरथ्यां कृतोदकः॥ दण्डाख्यमभिगम्यैव गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: Going then to Champa and offering oblations in Bhagirathi and going to Danda Tirtha, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: अधिगम्य महादेवं वरदं विष्णुमव्ययम्॥
en: Going to the great god, the giver of boons, the eternal Vishnu,

sa: अहं शिवश्च सोमश्च कश्यपोऽथ प्रजापतिः। अहंधाता विधाता च यज्ञश्चाहं द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, I am Shiva, I am Soma, I am Kashyapa, I am the lord of all treated things; I am Dhata, Vidhata, I am the sacrifice embodied.

sa: अज्ञातचर्या गूढेन पृथिव्यां विश्रुतेन च॥ दिवीव पार्थ सूर्येण न शक्याचरितं त्वया।
en: Known as you are all over the world, you will hardly be able to live unknown and undiscovered. O son of Pritha, the sun can never pass through the sky unknown to men.

sa: अचलं स्थानमासाद्य गाण्डीवमनुमन्त्र्य च। अमुञ्चं वज्रसंस्पर्शानायसान् निशितान् शरान्॥
en: Inspiring the Gandiva with mantras and aiming at the locality of the rocks, I discharged sharpened iron darts having the touch of the thunderbolt.

sa: एकवेदस्य चाज्ञानाद् वेदास्ते बहवः कृताः। सत्त्वस्य चेह विभ्रंशात् सत्ये कश्चिदवस्थितः॥
en: As men had no capacity to study the entire Veda, it came to be divided into several parts. And as the intellect (of men) deteriorated, few were devoted to truth.

sa: बस्तिमूलं गुदं चैव पावकं समुपाश्रितः। वहन् मूत्रं पूरीषं वाप्यपान: परिवर्तते॥
en: This (Samana) transforming itself to Apana air and supported by the head of the stomach carries the refuge matter of the body, such as urine to the kidneys and intestines.

sa: लोमश उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्त्वान्तरिक्षाच्च स राजा राजसत्तमः। यथोक्तं तच्चकाराथ श्रद्दधद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: Lomasha said : O best of the Bharata race, having heard these words uttered in the sky, that foremost of kings reverentially did all that he was directed to do.

sa: रथानामर्बुदं चापि पादाता बहवस्तथा। प्रमीयमाणमामं च पच्यमानं तथैव च॥
en: And also a hundred million of cars and numberless foot-soldiers. At one place raw food grains are being measured out and at another they all being cooked.

sa: यः सर्वलोकद्वाराणि नित्यं संचरते वशी। देवलोकाद् ब्रह्मलोकं गन्धर्वाप्सरसामपि।॥
en: Who, having controlled over senses, always wander over all the regions from the region of the celestials to those of Brahma, Gandharvas and Apsaras.

sa: शकुकर्णेश्वरं देवमर्चयित्वा युधिष्ठिर। अश्वमेधाद् दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, the wise men say that by worshipping the deity, Sankhakarneshvara, one obtains ten times the merit of Ashvamedha (sacrifice).

sa: ते वज्रवेगविहता दानवाः पर्वतोपमाः। इतरेतरमाश्लिष्य न्यपतन् पृथिवीतले॥
en: Then those Danavas, big as rocks smitten by the force of the thunder, fell on the ground clashing against one another,

sa: इदमेवंविधं कस्माद् देवा नावासयन्त्युत। पुरंदरपुराद्धीदं विशिष्टमिति लक्षये॥
en: “This city appears superior to that of Purandara. How is it that the Gods do not reside in such a place?"

sa: अस्यापि पायुपयन्तस्तथा स्याद् गुदसंज्ञितः। स्रोतांसि तस्माज्जायन्ते सर्वप्राणेषु देहिनाम्॥ अग्निवेगवहः प्राणो गुदान्ते प्रतिहन्यते। स ऊर्ध्वमागम्य पुनः समुत्क्षिपति पावकम्॥ पक्काशयस्त्वधो नाभ्यामूर्ध्वमामाशयः स्थितः। नाभिमध्ये शरीरस्य प्राणाः सर्वे प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: That portion of its seat extending to as far as the rectum, is called Apana and from that, arteries arise in the five airs Prana. Prana acted on by the heat, strikes against the extremity of Apana region and then recoiling, it reacts on the heat. Above the navel is the region of undigest food and below it, the region of digestion. Prana and all other airs of the system are seated in the navel.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच द्यूतप्रियश्च कौन्तेयो न स जानाति देवितुम्। समाहूतश्च राजेन्द्रो न शक्ष्यति निवर्तितुम्॥
en: Shakuni Said The son of Kunti (Yudhishthira) is very much fond of gambling, but he does now know how to play. That king of kings, (Yudhishthira) if asked to play, will not be able to refuse.

sa: पपात महती चोल्का सनिर्घाता महाभया। निष्प्रभश्चाभवत् सूर्यश्छन्नरश्मिस्तमोवृतः॥
en: Fearful meteors began to fall with thundering roars. Being enveloped by darkness, the sun became pale and his rays were obscured.

sa: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्च कृतलक्षणाः। कृते युगे समभवन् स्वकर्मनिरताः प्रजाः॥
en: In the Krita Yuga, the distinctive characteristics of the Brahmanas, the Kshatriyas, the Vaishyas and the Sudras were the same and all men were engaged in their own respective duties.

sa: दीर्घसत्रमुपासन्ते दीक्षिता नियतव्रताः॥
en: Being installed performed the longextending sacrifice with regulated vows.

sa: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे सेन्द्राः सहधनेश्वराः। नारदं प्रेषयामासुः श्वसनं च मनोजवम्॥
en: Thereupon all the celestials with Indra and the lord of wealth (Kubera) at their head sent (to Pradyumna) Narada and the god of wind (Vayu) with the speed of mind.

sa: स कम्पयन्निव महीं बलेन चतुरङ्गिणा। युयुधे पाण्डवश्रेष्ठः कर्णेनामित्रघातिना॥
en: Making the earth tremble by his troops of four kinds, that best of the Pandavas fought (a battle) with that slayer of foes Karna.

sa: अत्रानुवंशं पठतः शृणु मे कुरुनन्दन। उलूखलैराभरणैः पिशाची यदभाषत॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, hear what a Pishacha woman, adorned with pestles as her ornaments, said as I was reciting the table of genealogy.

sa: एवंसंस्थितिका सिद्धिरियं लोकस्य भारत। तत्र सिद्धिर्गतिः प्रोक्ता कालावस्थाविभागतः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the success of persons is thus situated; it is said that the course of success depends upon time and situation.

sa: इमं वैश्रवणावासं पुण्यं सिद्धनिषेवितम्। कथं भीम गमिष्यामो गतिरन्तरधीयताम्।१२।।
en: O Bhima, now we shall go to the yonder abode of Vaisravana (Kubera) frequented by the Siddhas. Think of the means of entering it."

sa: अथवा सिद्धिरेव स्यादभिमानं तदेव ते। वृकोदरस्य बीभत्सोमा॑त्रोश्च यमयोरपि॥
en: Even if you are unsuccessful it shall be proved to you. Vrikodara, Vivatsu and the twins (that you are unable to take the kingdom).

sa: यस्य यज्ञो बभूवेह बह्वन्नो बहुदक्षिणः। यत्रानपर्वता राजशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ घृतकुल्याश्च दध्नश्च नद्यो बहुशतास्तथा। व्यञ्जनानां प्रवाहाश्च महार्हाणां सहस्रशः॥
en: O king, here it was that he performed many sacrifices, in which food and gifts were in abundance and in which cooked rice was in hundreds and thousands of mountains. Ghee and curds were in hundreds of lakes and rivers and richly cooked curries in thousands of streams.

sa: निर्गतोऽहमकामस्तु इच्छया ते महाप्रभो। इच्छामि पुण्डरीकाक्ष ज्ञातुं त्वाहमनिन्दितम्॥
en: O great lord, I have come out through your desire and not mine. O lotus-eyed one, I desire to know you who are faultless.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच इति ब्रुवन् नलो राजा दमयन्तीं पुनः पुनः। सान्त्वयामास कल्याणी वाससोऽर्धेन संवृताम्॥ तावेकवस्त्रसंवीतावटमानावितस्ततः। क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्तौ सभां कांचिदुपेयतुः॥
en: Brihadhsava said: Thus repeatedly speaking unto Damayanti, used to all happiness, king Nala tried to console her, now clad only in half of her cloth. Both of them wrapped in a single piece of cloth, when wandering this way and that, arrived at an inn, worn out with hunger and thirst.

sa: अथ चेदिपतेर्माता राज्ञश्चान्तःपुरात् तदा। जगाम यत्र सा बाला ब्राह्मणेन सहाभवत्॥
en: Thereafter the mother of the king of the Nishadhas, having left the inner apartments of the palace, repaired to the place where that lady (Damayanti) was waiting with the Brahmana.

sa: श्रुत्वैव चाहं राजेन्द्र परमोद्विग्नमानसः। तूर्णमभ्यागतोऽस्मि त्वां द्रष्टुकामो विशाम्पते॥
en: Having heard this, O king of kings and having been stricken with great anxiety. I have speedily come here, O king, to see you.

sa: न्याययुक्तमिदं सर्वं भवता परिकीर्तितम्। न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचिद् धर्मेष्विह हि दृश्यते॥
en: The Brahmanas said: All this that you have told me is rational. It appears that there is nothing in connection with the mysteries of religion which you do not know.

sa: असांनिध्यं तु कौरव्य ममानर्तेष्वभूत् तदा। येनेदं व्यसनं प्राप्ता भवन्तो द्यूतकारितम्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, it is on account of my absence at that time from the country of Anartha that you have been beset by the misfortunes engendered by gambling.

sa: न तेऽन्यद् दैवतं किंचिद् दैवतेष्वपि वर्तते। प्रयतत्वाद् द्विजातीनां दमेनासि समन्वितः॥
en: There is not even among the celestials such a one as to deserve worship from you. By always subduing your senses you have acquired the self-control of the twice born.

sa: दुर्योधनश्चापि महीं प्रशास्ति न चास्य भूमिर्विवरं ददाति। नितीव मन्येत नरोऽल्पबुद्धिः॥
en: Duryodhana is ruling the earth; the earth does not swallow him up. From this men with little intelligent would consider that a sinful life is preferable to a virtuous one.

sa: धृतिमन्तश्च दक्षाश्च स्वे स्वे कर्मणि भारत। पराक्रमविधानज्ञा नरा कृतयुगेऽभवन्॥
en: O Bharata, men of the Kriti Yuga (golden age) were steady and skilled in their own respective affairs and were well versed in the rules of prowess.

sa: उपाहारनाहरन्तो देवतानां यथा द्विजाः। कुर्वन्ति तद्वदेताभ्यां करोम्यहमतन्द्रितः॥
en: As the Brahmanas try to procure offerings for their gods, so do I, with diligence for these two (my aged parents).

sa: एवमुक्तो यदि मया गृहणीयाद् वचनं मम। अनामयं स्याद्धर्मश्च कुरूणां कुरुवर्धन॥
en: Being thus accosted by me, if he had listened to my words, the well-being and the virtue of the Kurus, O enhancer of the Kuru race, would have been secured.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र संगमं लोकविश्रुतम्॥ सरस्वत्या महापुण्यं केशवं समुपासते। यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the Sangama, celebrated all over the world. A region of great sacredness, where the Sarasvati mixes with the sea. Here Keshava is worshipped by Brahma and other celestials, by Rishis and by ascetics.

sa: अतीव कृष्णसाराभ्यां रक्तान्ताभ्यां जलं तु तत्। परिस्रवन् नलो दृष्ट्वा शोकार्तामिदमब्रवीत्।॥
en: When Nala saw her thus oppressed with sorrow, he also shed tears from his eyes, which were black like those of the gazelle, with red extremities; and addressed her, saying:

sa: तदेतत् खपुरं दिव्यं चरत्यमरवर्जितम्। पौलोमाध्युषितं वीर कालकझैश्च दानवैः॥
en: This is that celestials city, devoid of gods, which is moving about. O hero, it is inhabited by the Pauloma and he Kalakeya Danavas.

sa: सख्यश्चास्या मया दृष्टास्ताभिश्चाप्युपलक्षितः। विस्मिताश्चाभवन् सर्वा दृष्ट्वा मां विबुधेश्वराः॥
en: I was preceived by her hand-maids, whom I saw too. O the foremost of the gods, beholding me they were all struck with ainazement.

sa: यथाप्रतिज्ञं विहतश्च कालः सर्वाः समा द्वादश निर्जनेषु। अज्ञातचर्यां विधिवत् समाप्य भवद्गताः केशव पाण्डवेयाः॥
en: We will spend the period of twelve years, as we have promised, in lonely forests. And then having duly completed the period of our are incognito life, O Keshava, the sons of Pandu will place themselves under your protection.

sa: वीरसेनसुतो यैस्तु राज्यात् प्रभ्रंशितः पुरा। अतर्कितविनाश्च देवनेन विशाम्पते॥
en: And in the days of yore Virasena's son was deprived of his kingdom. Do king of the earth, gambling brings on unthought of misfortunes.

sa: तस्योदरे मया दृष्टाः सर्वे रत्नविभूषिताः। सिंहान् व्याघ्रान् वराहांश्च पश्यामि मनुजाधिप॥
en: Were seen by me in his stomach. They were all decked with gems and jewels. O ruler of men, I saw also there the lions, the tigers and the bears.

sa: तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र इल्वलो ब्रह्महासुरः। मन्युमान् भ्रातरं छागं मायावी ह्यकरोत् ततः॥
en: O king of kings, from that day the Asura Ilvala became a destroyer of Brahmanas. Endued as he was with the power of illusion, he made his brother a goat.

sa: अथ ज्येष्ठिमासाद्य तीर्थं परमदुर्लभम्। तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then going to the inaccessible Tirtha, called Jyeshthila and living there for one night one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: ततो नालीकनाराचैर्भल्लैः शक्त्यष्टितोमरैः। प्रत्यघ्नन् दानवेन्द्रा मां क्रुद्धास्तीव्रपराक्रमाः॥
en: Then those foremost of the Danavas (possessed) of fiery prowess, angrily assailed me with Nalikas, Narachas, Bhallas, Maces, swords and Tomaras.

sa: भीमबाहुबलोत्पिष्टे विनष्टे राक्षसे ततः। विविशुस्ते वनं वीराः क्षेमं निहतकण्टकम्॥
en: After the Rakshasas had been killed by the strength of arms of Bhima, the heroes. (the Pandavas) entered that peaceful forest (now) being free from its pest.

sa: ते वध्यमाना दैतेयाः पुरमास्थाय तत् पुनः खमुत्पेतुः सनगरा मायामास्थाय दानवीम्॥
en: Thus smitten (by me) those sons of Diti, taking refuge in that city, again rose up in the air with it, by the help of illusion peculiar to the Danavas.

sa: स संनिकर्षमागम्य पार्थस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। मूकं नाम दनोः पुत्रं ददर्शाद्भुतदर्शनम्॥ वाराहं रूपमास्थाय तर्कयन्तमिवार्जुनम्। हन्तुं परं दीप्यमानं तमुवाचाथ फाल्गुनः॥ गाण्डीवं धनुरादाय शरांचाशीविषोपमान्। सज्यंधनुर्वरं कृत्वा ज्याघोषेण निनादयन्॥
en: Coming near Partha of spotless deeds, he (Shiva) saw that a son of a Danava, named Muka of wonderful appearance. Assuming the form of a boar, intended to kill Arjuna. Seeing him in the attempt to kill him. (At once) taking up his Gandiva bow and virulently poisonous snake-like arrows and also stringing them to the bow and having filled all sides with its twang, Falguni said to him.

sa: व्याध उवाच प्रज्ञया मानसं दुःखं हन्याच्छारीरमौषधैः। एतद् विज्ञानसामर्थ्य न बालैः समतामियात्॥
en: The Fowler said: The bodily disease should be cured with medicines and the mental ones by spiritual wisdom. This is the power of knowledge. Knowing this, the wise should not behave like boys.

sa: तत् पुरं खचरं दिव्यं कामगं सूर्यसप्रभम्। दैतेयैर्वरदानेनधार्यते स्म यथासुखम्॥
en: (But) the sons of Diti, on the strength of their boon, easily supported themselves on that celestials and aerial city of sun-like splendour and moving at will.

sa: हनूमानुवाच प्रसीद नास्ति मे शक्तिरुत्थातुं जरयानघ। ममानुकम्पया त्वेतत् पुच्छमुत्सार्य गम्यताम्॥
en: Hanuman said: O sinless one, be kind towards me. I have no strength to rise in consequence of old age. From pity for me go by moving aside my tail.

sa: हिडिम्बबकयोः पाप न त्वमश्रुप्रमार्जनम्। करिष्यसि गतश्चापि यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: “O sinful wretch, you will no more have to wine away the tears of Hidimba and Baka, for you too are going to the abode of Yama.”

sa: अर्जुनश्च यमौ चोभौ सर्वे ते प्राहसंस्तदा। नामर्षयत् ततस्तेषामवहासममर्षणः॥
en: Arjuna, and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) all laughed aloud. Ever incapable of putting up with insults, he (Duryodhana) could not bear their laughter.

sa: विना सिद्धगति वीर गतिरत्र न विद्यते। देवलोकस्य मार्गोऽयमगम्यो मानुषैः सदा॥
en: O hero, except success in asceticism there is no other means to go to that place. This is the way to the celestials regions. It is always impassable by men.

sa: तयोरासीत् सुतुमुलः सम्प्रहारः सुदारुणः। नखदंष्ट्रायुधवतोर्व्याघ्रयोरिव दृप्तयोः॥
en: Or like two mighty tigers armed with teeth and claws. The fight between them was fierce and hard.

sa: चतुर्दशीमष्टमी च रामं पश्यन्ति तापसाः। अस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां भवित्री वश्चतुर्दशी॥
en: The ascetics see Rama on the fourteenth and eighth day of the lunar month. At the close of this night, the fourteenth day of the lunar course will set in.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यथा क्रुद्धो हुतवहस्तपस्तप्तुं वनं गतः॥
en: Markandeya said : This is the old history cited as an instance, in which (is related) why Agni in wrath went to the forest to perform asceticismi.

sa: प्रहरस्व शरानेतान् नाराचान् मर्मभेदिनः। इत्युक्तो बाणवर्षं स मुमोच सहसार्जुनः॥
en: Shoot at me your best arrows that are capable of piercing to the very heart." Having been thus addressed, Arjuna poured a shower of arrows upon him.

sa: नीलस्य राज्ञो दुहिता बभूवातीवशोभना। साग्निहोत्रमुपातिष्ठद् बोधनाय पितुः सदा॥
en: The daughter of the king Nila was exceedingly handsome. She always used to stay near her father's Agnihotra (sacred fire) to stir it up.

sa: अङ्गिरा उवाच कुरु पुण्यं पुरजास्वयं भवाग्निस्तिमिरापहः। मां च देव कुरुष्वाग्ने प्रथम पुत्रमञ्जसा॥
en: Angiras said: O deity of fire, do you become the fire-god and the destroyer of darkness. Do you attend to your sacred duty of clearing people's way to heaven. O god, make me your first child.

sa: व्यथितोऽस्मि महायुद्धे भयं चागान्महन्मम। ततोऽहं देवदेवाय रुद्राय प्रयतो रणे॥
en: I was afflicted in that terrible encounter and was seized with a dreadful terror. Thereupon, mustering up (courage), I (bowed down) to the god of gods, Rudra,

sa: एवमुक्तस्तुधर्मात्मा सत्यसंधो युधिष्ठिरः। नैतदस्तीति सक्रोधो भर्त्सयामास राक्षसम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the virtuousminded and stead-fast in his pledges, Yudhishthira, saying “It cannot be," rebuked the Rakshasas in anger.

sa: वडवाग्निः पिबत्यम्भो योऽसौ परमदारुणः। ऊर्श्वभागूर्ध्वभाङ्नाम कविः प्राणाश्रितस्तु यः॥
en: That terrible water-drinking sea fire called Vadava has the tendency to go upwards and hence it is called Urdhvabhaga, It stands in the Prana.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच इमे सभायामुपनीतशास्त्राः क्रियावन्तः सर्व एवेन्द्रकल्पाः। गुरुस्थाना गुरवश्चैव सर्वे तेषामग्रे नोत्सहे स्थातुमेवम्॥
en: O Wretch, O man of cruel deeds, do not make me uncovered. Do not drag me in this way. The princes (the Pandavas) will not pardon you, even if the celestial with Indra become your allies.

sa: ऊष्मा चैवोष्मणो जज्ञे सोऽग्निधूतस्य लक्ष्यते। अग्निश्चापि मनु म प्राजापत्यमकारयत्॥
en: Another son was also born to him, named Ushma. This fire is seen in all vapours. Another son named Manu was also born; he officiated as Prajapatya.

sa: ऊर्जस्करान् हव्यवाहान् सुवर्णसदृशप्रभान्। ततस्तपो ह्यजनयत् पञ्च यज्ञसुतानिह॥
en: Tapa thus created the five Urjaskara fires, they were as brilliant as gold. They all partake of the Soma in sacrifices.

sa: जयन्तो हन्यमाना वा प्राप्तुमर्हाम सद्गतिम्। राक्षसे जीवमानेऽद्य रविरस्तमियाद् यदि॥
en: We should gain the blessed state, either by defeating the foe or by being killed by him. If the sun sets today and the Rakshasa remains alive.

sa: क्रोधमाहारयद् भीमो राक्षसं चेदमब्रवीत्। विज्ञातोऽसि मया पूर्वं पाप शस्त्रपरीक्षणे॥
en: Was inflamed with anger and he thus spoke to the Rakshasa, "O sinful wretch, I found you out long ago by (observing) your scrutiny of our weapons.

sa: विक्रीड्य तस्मिन् सुचिरमुत्ततारामितद्युतिः। ततोऽध्यगन्तुं वेगेन तद् वनं बहुपादपम्॥
en: Having sported there for a long while, that immeasurably effulgent hero got up in order to enter quickly into the forest abounding in trees.

sa: तथैव हठदुर्बुद्धिः शक्तः कर्मण्यकर्मकृत्। आसीत न चिरं जीवेदनाथ इव दुर्बलः॥
en: So also that man, who believes in chance and who, though capable of work, does not work, does not live long, for his life is one of weakness and helplessness.

sa: सिद्धार्था वसुमन्तश्च सा त्वं प्रीतिमवाप्नुहि। अनुज्ञातस्त्वया चाहं द्वारकां गन्तुमुत्सहे॥
en: They have obtained vast wealth, and they have been crowned with success. Be pleased with all this; with your permission I shall now to go to Dwarka.

sa: ततः संचोदयामास सोऽर्जुनं भ्रातृनन्दनम्। दर्शयास्त्राणि कौन्तेय यैर्जिता दानवास्त्वया॥
en: Then he (Yudhishthira) said to Arjuna, the joy of his mother, “O son of Kunti, show me the weapons whereby you destroyed the Danavas."

sa: तत्राश्रौषं नरव्याघ्र शाल्वं सागरमन्तिकात्। प्रयान्तं सौभमास्थाय तमहं पृष्ठतोऽन्वयाम्॥
en: O best of men, here did I hear that Shalva was coursing in his (car) Saubha near the ocean. I soon followed him there.

sa: आरुज्यारुज्य तौ वृक्ष्यानन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः। जीमूताविव गर्जन्तौ निनदन्तौ महाबलौ॥
en: Uprooting the trees, those two greatly strong heroes again and again struck each other, roaring and shouting like masses of clouds.

sa: विमानगामिनश्चात्र दृश्यन्ते बहवोऽम्बरे। ततोऽपश्यं वसून् रुद्रान् साध्यांश्च समरुद्गणान्॥
en: And numerous rangers of the sky are to be seen in the air. I then, beheld the Vasus, the Rudras, the Saddhyas, the Marutas,

sa: भ्रातुर्वचनमाज्ञाय पाण्डवा धर्मचारिणः। यथार्ह नृपतीन् सर्वानेककैकं समनुव्रजन्॥
en: Having been thus commanded by their brothers, the virtuous Pandava princes followed the kings one after the other as each deserved.

sa: कर्म खल्विह कर्तव्यं जानतामित्रकर्शन। अकर्माणो हि जीवन्ति स्थावरा नेतरे जनाः॥
en: O represser of enemies, forsooth every conscious being should engage in actions in this world; it is only the immobile and not even other creatures that can live without action.

sa: विपरीतास्तदा नार्यो वञ्चयित्वार्हतः पतीन्। व्युच्चरन्त्यपि दुःशीला दासैः पशुभिरेव च॥
en: Women, prone to impropriety of conduct and distinguished by bad manners, deceive even the best of husbands and forget themselves with servants and slaves, even with animals,

sa: जन्मवृद्धिमिवार्थानां यो वृद्धिमभिकाडक्षते। एधते ज्ञातिषु स वै सद्यो वृद्धिर्हि विक्रमः॥
en: He, who always wishes for the increase of his wealth, grows and prospers amongst his relatives, as the body naturally grows from the day of birth. Prowess brings speedy growth.

sa: ततः स कुरुराजस्य क्रतुः सर्वसमृद्धिमान्। यूनां प्रीतिकरो राजन् स बभौ विपुलौजसः॥ शान्तविघ्नः सुखारम्भः प्रभूतधनधान्यवान्! अन्नवान् बहुभक्ष्यश्च केशवेन सुरक्षितः॥
en: O king, furnished with plentiful of corn, rice and every king of food and with abundance of wealth that sacrifice of the greatly effulgent king of the Kurus, blessed with every king of prosperity, and well protected by Keshava, commenced with all auspicious ceremonies and became exceedingly beautiful and pleasing to all young men.

sa: ते जग्मुस्तूर्णमाकाशंधनाधिपतिवाजिनः। प्रकर्षन्त इवाभ्राणि पिबन्त इव मारुतम्॥
en: The steeds of the lord of wealth careered along the firmament as if drawing forwards the sky and drinking the atmosphere.

sa: ववन्दे तत् तदा "प्तैर्हस्ताग्रमपरे प्रत्यर्पिषन्नमर्षिताः। र दशनैरोष्ठानदशन् क्रोधमूर्छिताः॥
en: Some rubbed in anger their palms with their fore fingers, others, being deprived of their senses by anger, bit their lips with their teeth,

sa: समाहूतो हुतवहः सोऽद्भुतः सूर्यमण्डलात्॥ विनिःसृत्य ययौ वह्निर्वाग्यतो विधिवत् प्रभुः। आगम्याहवनीयं वै तैर्द्विजैर्मन्त्रतो हुतम्॥ स तत्र विविधं हव्यं प्रतिगृह्य हुताशनः। ऋषिभ्यो भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रायच्छत दिवौकसाम्॥
en: The Adbhuta fire, that carrier of oblations, was invoked with mantras. Coming out of the disc of the sun, that exalted fire restrained his speech and went there. O best of the Bharata race, entering the sacrificial fire that had been made and into which various offerings were made by the Rishis with mantras, the fire took them with him and made them over to the dwellers of heaven.

sa: अम्बरीषश्च नाभाग इष्टवान् यमुनामनु। यत्रेष्ट्वा दश पद्मानि सदस्येभ्योऽभिसृष्टवान्॥
en: The son of Nabhaga, Ambrisha, performed a sacrifice near the Yumuna in which he gave away ten padmas (of gold coins) to the Sadasyas.

sa: एतादृशस्य किं मेऽद्य जीवितेन विशाम्पते। वर्धन्ते पाण्डवा नित्यं वयं त्वस्थिरवृद्धयः॥
en: O king, when the state of my mind is such, when the Pandavas are daily growing in prosperity and our possessions are daily decreasing, what do I care for life?

sa: मान्या हि गुरवः सर्वे एकपत्न्यस्तथा स्त्रियः। पतिव्रतानां शुश्रूषा दुष्करा प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: All venerable persons are to be respected, as also the women who are devoted to one husband. The service, that chaste women offer to their husbands, seems to me to be very difficult.

sa: भूयः संचिन्तयामास न न्याय्यं क्षुभितो ह्यहम्। साध्व्यः पत्न्यो द्विजेन्द्राणामकामाः कामयाम्यहम्॥ नैताः शक्या मया द्रष्टुं स्प्रष्टुं वाप्यनिमित्ततः। गार्हपत्यं समाविश्य तस्मात् पश्याम्यभीक्ष्णशः॥
en: Restraining his heart, he considered to be very improper it to be thus moved (will desire). He thought, “The wives of these illustrated Brahınanas are chaste and faithful. They are beyond the reach of other people's desires. I am filled with desire to possess them. I shall therefore by becoming their household fire gratify myself with daily looking at them.”

sa: ततो वेणां समासाद्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ मयूरहंससंयुक्तं विमानं लभते नरः।
en: Then going to Vena one should offer oblations to the Pitris and the celestials. (By doing this) a man obtains a car drawn by peacocks and cranes.

sa: ततः कुब्जाम्रकं गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। गोसहस्रमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: O ruler of men, one should then go to Kubjamraka; one then obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and goes to the celestials region.

sa: शृङ्गाणि त्रीणि पुण्यानि त्रीणि प्रस्रवणानि च। सर्वाण्यनुपरिक्रम्य यथाकाममुपस्पृश।॥
en: There are three peaks and three sacred springs; you may walk round them all one by one; you can perform your oblations at pleasure.

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ हिमवत्सुतमर्बुदम्। पृथिव्यां यत्र वै छिद्रं पूर्वमासीद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O virtuous king, O Yudhishthira, he should then go to the son of Himavata, named Arvuda, where there is a hole through the earth from ancient days.

sa: क्लीबे दारक्रिया यादृगन्धे वा रूपदर्शनम्। अराज्ञो राजवत् पूजा तथा ते मधुसूदन॥.
en: O slayer of Madhu, as a wife is to an impotent man and a beautiful sight to a blind man, so is this worship to you who are not a king (at all).

sa: इन्द्र उवाच क्रूरकर्मास्त्रवित् तात भविष्यसि परंतप। यदर्थमस्त्राणीप्सुस्त्वं तं काम पाण्डवाप्नुहि॥
en: Indra said: O tormentor of foes, O child, you will achieve terrible feats (of arms). And that desire of yours which makes you eager to obtain weapons shall be fulfilled.

sa: दुर्योधनं समासाद्य सामात्यं भरतर्षभ। दुःखार्तो भरतश्रेष्ठमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, having come before Duryodhana (sitting) with his counsellors he spoke thus in a sorrowful heart.

sa: दुर्योधनो मदेनैष क्षेमं राष्ट्रादपोहति। विषाणं गौरिव मदात् स्वयमारुजतेऽऽत्मनः॥
en: In consequence of this intoxication, Duryodhana forcibly drives away luck and prosperity from his kingdom like an infuriated bull who breaks his own hours.

sa: शरीरं यस्य निर्देष्टुमशक्यं तु सुरासुरैः। तस्यास्यमभवद् घोरं तीक्ष्णाग्रदशनं महत्॥
en: His body was incapable of being measured by the Suras and the Asuras. His mouth was fearful; it was of huge size with teeth of sharpened ends.

sa: यदि भीताश्च कौन्तेयाः कृपणाश्च तपस्विनः। ननु त्वयापि बोद्धव्यं यां पूजां माधवार्हसि॥
en: O Janardana, if the helpless sons of Kunti are frightened, and if they have become mean for their asceticism, you ought to have enlightened them as to your claim to the first worship.

sa: प्रार्थयेद् यदि मां कश्चिद् दण्ड्यस्ते स पुमान् भवेत्। वध्यश्च तेऽसकृन्मन्द इति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥
en: If any body shall solicit me (to be his wife), that person must be punished by you. Or should he solicit me repeatedly, that criminal person shall be punished with death. This is the vow that I have prearranged.

sa: बीजानि चैव सर्वाणि यथोक्तानि द्विजैः पुरा। तस्यामारोहयेर्नावि सुसंगुप्तानि भागशः॥
en: Take with you all the different seeds which were enumerated in the days of yore by the twice-born Brahmanas; and you must separately and carefully preserve them.

sa: नैतादृशं दैवतमस्ति सत्ये सर्वेषु लोकेषु सदेवकेषु। यथा पतिस्तस्य त सर्वकाम लभ्याः प्रसादात् कुपितश्च हन्यात्॥
en: O Satyabhama, in all the worlds including that of the celestials, there is no god equal to the husband. When gratified with you, you may get (from your husband) ever object of desire, but when angry, all of them may be lost.

sa: सर्वमेतत् करिष्यामि दिष्ट्या ते व्रतमीदृशम्। एवमुक्त्वा ततो भैमी राजमाता विशाम्पते॥ उवाचेदं दुहितरं सुनन्दा नाम भारत। सैरन्ध्रीमभिजानीष्व सुनन्दे देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: 'I will do all this. Very good is this your vow.' O monarch! the daughter of king Bhima was thus addressed by the Queen-mother. O Bharata! she called her daughter Sunanda and spoke to her this: 'O Sunanda! know well that this maiden is a goddess, even as your Shairindhri (a high class maid-servant).

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच अन्धस्य पन्था बधिरस्य पन्थाः स्त्रियः पन्था भारवाहस्य पन्थाः। राज्ञः पन्था ब्राह्मणेनासमेत्य समेत्य तु ब्राह्मणस्यैव पन्थाः॥
en: Ashtavakra said: When no Brahmana passes along a path, it then belongs first to the blind, then to the deaf, then to women, then to the carriers of burden and then (last of all) to the king But when a Brahmana is met on the way, it solely belongs to him.

sa: नौश्च कारयितव्या ते दृढा युक्तवटारका। तत्र सप्तर्षिभिः सार्धमारुहेथा महामुने॥
en: You should (at once) build a strong and huge ark and furnish it with a long rope. O great Rishis, get into it with the seven Rishis.

sa: ब्राह्मणाः साग्निहोत्राश्च तथैव च निरग्नयः। स्वाध्यायिनो भिक्षवश्च तथैव वनवासिनः॥ बहवो ब्राह्मणास्तत्र परिवव॒र्युधिष्ठिरम्। तप:सिद्धा महात्मानः शतशः संशितव्रताः॥
en: The Brahmanas, some offering sacrifice to the fire, some without it, some engaged in the study of the Vedas, some depending upon alms and some living in the forest, all these numberless Brahmanas as well as hundreds of Mahatamas of accomplished ascetic piety and hard austerities surrounded Yudhishthira.

sa: जानीमहे देवितं सौबलस्य वेद द्यूते निकृति पर्वतीयः। यतः प्राप्तः शकुनिस्तत्र यातु मा यूयुधो भारत पाण्डवेयान्॥
en: We all know the skill of the son of Subala (Shakuni) in play. This mountain king knows many nefarious methods of gambling. Let Shakuni go back to the place whence he has come. O descendant of Bharata, do not rage a war with the Pandavas.

sa: असंख्येयास्तु कौन्तेय यक्षराक्षसकिनराः। नागाः सुपर्णा गन्धर्वाः कुबेरसदनं प्रति॥
en: In great members, also the Yakshas, the Rakshasha, the Kinnaras, the Nagas, the Suparnas, the Gandharvas when they go to the palace of Kubera.

sa: इमामवस्थां सम्प्राप्तो ह्यहं कोपान्मनीषिणाम्। शापस्यान्तं परिप्रेप्सुः सर्वं तत् कथयामि ते॥
en: I have been brought down to this state on account of the anger of the Maharshis, now desirous of expiating the curse I shall relate to you all about it.

sa: श्रुत्वा सूतस्तद्वचो याज्ञसेन्याः सभां गत्वा प्राह वाक्यं तदानीम्। निर्बन्धं तं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य बुद्ध्वा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of Yajnaseni (Draupadi), the Suta returned to the Sabha and repeated her words. But all sat with downcast faces, knowing the eagerness and resolution of the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana).

sa: श्रुत्वा स्वरं द्वारगतस्य भर्तुः प्रत्युत्थिता तिष्ठ गृहस्य मध्ये। दृष्ट्वा प्रविष्टं त्वरिताऽऽसनेन पायेन चैनं प्रतिपूजयस्व॥
en: Hearing the voice of your husband at the gate, rise from your seat and stay in readiness within the room. As soon as you see him enter your room, worship him by offering him a seat and water to wash his feet.

sa: स तु धुन्धुर्वरं लब्वा महावीर्यपराक्रमः। अनुस्मरन् पितृवधं दुतं विष्णुमुपागमत्॥
en: The most courageous and energetic Dhundhu, too, speedily advanced to Vishnu, after gaining this boon and also recollecting the murder of his father (by that god). at

sa: ईषच्चपलकर्माणं मनुष्यमिह भारत। द्विषन्ति सर्वभूतानि ताडयन्ति च राक्षसाः॥
en: At this place, O Bharata all creatures are hostile to and the Rakshasas chastise that man who may have even the very slightest presumption.

sa: ते वयं पाण्डवं सर्वे गृहीतास्त्रमरिंदमम्। द्रष्टारो न हि बीभत्सुर्भारमुद्यम्य सीदति॥
en: We the Pandavas shall all see that chastiser of foes (Arjuna) fully equipped with celestials weapons, for Vibhatsu (Arjuna) (Arjuna) when undertaking a task never droops down under its weight.

sa: भीष्मे शान्तनवे राजन् स्थिते पुरुषसत्तमे। स्वच्छन्दमृत्युके राजन् कथं कृष्णोऽर्चितस्त्वया॥
en: O king, when that best of men, the son of Shantanu, old Bhishma, who can die only at his will, is here, why have you worshipped Krishna?

sa: ते वृत्रं निहतं दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षेणधीमता। जीवितं परिरक्षन्तः प्रविष्टा वरुणालयम्॥
en: Having seen Vritra killed by the greatly intelligent deity of one thousand eyes (Indra), they entered into the ocean) the abode of Varuna, to save their lives,

sa: विदितस्तेऽर्जुनो वीरः स स्वर्गफलमाप्नुयात्। त्वं तु शक्राभ्यनुज्ञाता तस्य पादान्तिकं व्रज। तदेवं कुरु कल्याणि प्रसन्नस्त्वांधनंजयः॥
en: Is the heroic Arjuna, thus known to you. O blessed lady, he is made to taste the fruits (pleasure) of heaven. At the command of Shakra (Indra) let him today obtain your feet. Do this, for Dhananjaya (Arjuna) is inclined to you.

sa: योनिद्वारं च तत्रैव विश्रुतं भरतर्षभ। तत्राभिगम्य मुच्येत पुरुषो योनिसंकटात्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, there is the Tirtha known by the name of Yonidvara. Going there a man is freed from the pain of rebirth.

sa: दशकोटीर्हिरण्यस्य रुक्मभारांस्तथा दश। एतद् ददामि विप्रर्षे सर्वज्ञस्त्वं मतो हि मे॥
en: I bestow on you one hundred millions of coins and ten Bharas (each bhara is equal to 32 maunds) of gold. According to my belief you are conversant with everything.

sa: पूजयामास चैवाथ विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणः। यथार्हममितात्मानं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: And that generous one (Yudhishthira) duly worshipped (Indra) of immeasurable soul as befitting his dignity having strict regard to proper forin.

sa: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनोधनमाप्नुयात्। महीं विजयते राजा वैश्योधनमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: (By reciting it) the sonless obtain sons, the poor obtain wealth, the king conquers the world and the Vaisyas obtain affluence.

sa: सीधुपानेन चाल्पनं तुष्ट्याथ मदनेन च। विलासनैश्च विविधैः प्रेक्षणीयतराभवत्॥
en: Exhilarated with the little liquor she had drunk and excited also by desire she moved in many attitudes and looked more beautiful than ever.

sa: क्लेशैस्तीत्रैर्युज्यमानः सपत्नैः क्षमां कुर्वन् कालमुपासते यः। संवर्धयन् स्तोकमिवाग्निमात्मवान् स वै भुङ्क्ते पृथिवीमेक एव॥
en: That wise man, who patiently bearing all the wrongs done to him by his enemies, bides his time and multiplies his resources by degrees as a man makes a small fire a large one, rules alone this entire earth.

sa: एवमेते महोत्पाताः प्रादुरासन् दुरासदाः। भरतानामभावाय राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव॥
en: O king, thus extraordinary and fearful protents were seen and heard, indicating the destruction of the Bharata race the consequence of your evil counsels;

sa: फाल्गुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा गतसंज्ञा तदोर्वशी। गन्धर्ववचनं सर्वं श्रावयामास तं तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard the words of Falguni (Arjuna) Urvashi became deprived of her senses. She then told him all that was told to her by the Gandharva (Chitrasena).

sa: एष ते ब्रह्महा यज्ञं मा द्रष्टुं प्रविशेदिति। ब्रह्महा प्रेक्षितेनापि पीडयेत् त्वामसंशयम्॥
en: "See that this killer of a Brahmana may not enter your sacrifice. Do not also look at him, for even a glance at a killer of a Brahmana can certainly do you harm."

sa: इत्येतां नारदश्चिन्तां चिन्तयामास सर्ववित्। हरि नारायणं ध्यात्वा यज्ञैरीज्यन्तमीश्वरम्॥
en: Thus reflected the omniscient Narada who knew that Hari, Narayana, (Krishna) was no other than the Supreme Being, whom every body worships with sacrifices.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच असंशयं माधव सत्यमेतद् गृहणीम ते वाक्यमदीनसत्त्व। स्वाभ्यां भुजाभ्यामजितां तु भूमि नेच्छेत् कुरूणामृषभः कथंचित्॥
en: Krishna said: O descendant of Madhu, there is no doubt what you say is true. O greatly courageous hero, we accept your words. This foremost of Kurus, (Yudhishthira) does not desire to possess the land that is not won by his won prowess of arms.

sa: तथा वने तान् वसतः प्रवीरान् स्वाध्यायवन्तश्च तपोधनाचा स्तान् पूजयामासुरथो नरायाः॥
en: When they began to live there, many venerable ascetics, learned in the Vedas, often came to see them. Those foremost of men always received those Veda-knowing Rishis with great respect.

sa: न चावतारयामास चेष्टमानो यथाबलम्। तस्य पुत्रः समभवच्छ्रीमान्धर्मपरायणः॥ भगीरथ इति ख्यातः सत्यवागनसूयकः। अभिषिच्य तु तं राज्ये दिलीपो वनमाश्रितः॥
en: Though he tried it with all his mighi, he could not bring her down (1O earth). A virtuous and handsome son was then born to him. He was truthful and without malice and he was known by the name of Bhagiratha. Installing him in the kingdom, Dilipa retired into the forest.

sa: ततः कदाचित् कुशल: कथासु विप्रोऽभ्यगच्छद् भुवि कौरवेयान्। स तैः समेत्याथ यदृच्छयैव वैचित्रवीर्यं नृपमभ्यगच्छत्॥
en: Thereupon one day there came to the Kuru princes a certain Brahmana who was celebrated on carth for his powers of speech. Having talked with them for some time, he went away to the king, the of Vichitravirya (Dhritarashtra).

sa: तानप्यसौ मातलिरभ्यनन्दत् पितेव पुत्राननुशिष्य पार्थान्। ययौ रथेनाप्रतिमप्रभेण पुनः सकाशं त्रिदिवेश्वरस्य॥
en: Matali too then greeted them and having instructed the Parthas as a father does his (own) sons, (he) returned to the lord of heaven, ascending that car of unrivalled splendour.

sa: केचिद् धर्मार्थकुशलाः केचित् तत्र महाव्रताः। रेमिरे कथयन्तश्च सर्वभाष्यविदां वरा:॥
en: Some amongst them, learned in the interpretations of Shastras, and some others of rigid vows, well acquainted with every commentary and gloss, engaged themselves in pleasant conversations.

sa: तामापतन्ती सम्प्रेक्ष्य गन्धर्वाणां महाचमूम्। महता शरवर्षेण सोऽभ्यवर्षदरिंदमः॥
en: Seeing the greatly powerful Gandharva army rushing towards him, that chastiser of foes hurled on them a thick shower of arrows.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु कौन्तेयो बभूवास्वस्थचेतनः। अनिष्टदर्शनान् घोरानुत्पातान् परिचिन्तयन्॥
en: On the other hand, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, beholding and thinking of terrible ill omens became uneasy.

sa: प्रावर्ततैवं यज्ञः स पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। पृथिव्यामेकवीरस्य शक्रस्येव त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: Thus like the sacrifice formerly performed by Shakra (Indra) in heaven, began the sacrifice of that matchless hero, the illustrious Pandava (Yudhishthira), on earth.

sa: प्रतिषिद्धो मया तात रैभ्यावसथदर्शनात्। गतवानेव तं द्रष्टुं कालान्तकयमोपमम्॥
en: O child, I prohibited you from visiting the residence of Raivya, but you went there to visit it which was like the all-destroying death.

sa: समुच्चरन्त्यतिवादाश्च वक्त्राद् पैराहतः शोचति रात्र्यहानि। परस्य नामर्मसु ते पतन्त तान् पण्डितो नावसृजेत् परेषु॥
en: One man utters from his lips words that are harsh. Stung by them the other burns day and night. Those words pierce the very heart of another. Therefore, the learned men should never utter such (harsh) words towards others.

sa: तेषु ते न्यवसन् राजन् ब्राह्मणानृपसत्कृताः। कथयन्तः कथां बह्वीः पश्यन्तो नटनर्तकान्॥
en: O king, having been duly worshipped by the king, Brahmanas continued to live there, passing their time in conversation on various topics and seeing the performance of actors and dancers.

sa: दमयन्त्यपि तं दुष्टमुपलभ्य पतिव्रता। तीव्ररोषसमाविष्टा प्रजज्वालेव मन्युना॥
en: The chaste Damayanti then understanding the intentions of this evil-minded one, possessed with fierce rage, seemed to blaze forth in anger.

sa: ततः परमधर्मात्मा काश्यपः सर्वधर्मवित्। विवादिनावनुप्राप्तौ तावुभौ प्रेत्यवेदयत्॥
en: Then the highly righteous Kashyapa versed in all duties stepping between the disputants inquired of them the cause of their quarrel.

sa: दमयन्त्युवाच न मामर्हसि कल्याण दोषेण परिशङ्कितुम्। मया हि देवानुत्सृज्य वृतस्त्वं निषधाधिप॥
en: Damayanti said : O ruler of the Nishadhas, O blessed one, it behoves you not to suspect any fault in me; for I have selected you as my husband, discarding all the celestials.

sa: गाण्डीवधन्वा च वृकोदरश्च संरम्भिणावन्तककालकल्पौ। न शेषयेतां युधि शत्रुसेनां शरान् किरन्तावशनिप्रकाशान्॥
en: The wielder of Gandiva (Arjuna) and Bhima when angry are like Yama and Kala themselves. Hurling their arrows which are like so many thunderbolts, they exterminate their enemies in battle.

sa: ततः शक्राभ्यनुज्ञात आसने विष्टरोत्तरे। निषसाद द्विजश्रेष्ठः पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः॥
en: Having been worshipped by the great Rishis, that best of the twice-born sat at the . desire of Shakra (Indra) on an excellent seat.

sa: वामदेव उवाच घोरं व्रतं ब्राह्मणस्यैतदाहुरेतद् राजन् यदिहाजीवमानः। अयस्मया घोररूपा महान्तश्चत्वारो वा यातुधानाः सुरौद्राः। मया प्रयुक्तास्त्वद्वधमीप्समाना वहन्तु त्वां शितशूलाश्चतु॥
en: Vamadeva said: O king, very severe vows have been ordained for the Brahmanas. If I have observed them, then let. four fearful and mightyRakshasas of terrible appearance and iron body pursue you at my command and kill you and then carry you on their sharp lances after cutting up your body into four parts.

sa: धनुषाक्षस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा मेधाविनमनामयम्। निमित्तमस्य महिषैर्भेदयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: Thereupon having seen this, Dhanushakha caused the mountain which was the instrumental cause of his life to be shattered by buffaloes.

sa: स पुत्रशोकादुद्विग्नस्तपस्तेपे सुदुष्करम्। भवेन्मम सुतोऽमर्त्य इति तं लब्धवांश्च सः॥
en: Being afflicted with grief for the death of his son, he performed great asceticism, to get a child who would be immortal. He obtained such a son.

sa: एतेषां पुत्रवर्गाश्च शिष्याश्च भरतर्षभ। बभूवर्होत्रगाः सर्वे वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the disciples and the sons of these men, all well-acquainted with the Vedas, became Hotragas,

sa: विलासिनीभिरत्यर्थं नृत्यन्तीभिः समन्ततः। वायुनाधूयमानाभिः पताकाभिरलंकृतम्॥
en: And beautiful with coquettish damsels dancing around and ornamented with flags fluttered by the wind.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच दपस्ते भविता तात वसल्लब्ध्वा यथेप्सितान्। स दर्पपूर्णः कृपणः क्षिप्रमेव विनक्ष्यसि॥
en: Bharadvaja said : O son, as you have obtained all that you desired, you (as a matter of course) will (now) be proud. And when you will be filled with pride, destruction will soon overtake you.

sa: इन्द्रसेनो विशोकश्च पूस्चार्जुनसारथिः। अन्नाद्याहरणे युक्ताः सन्तु मत्प्रियकाम्यया॥
en: Let Indrasena and Vishoka and the charioteer of Arjuna, Puru, if, they desire to please me, be employed in collecting them.

sa: निवर्ततागता दूरं समागमनशापिताः। स्वजने न्यासभूते मे कार्या स्नेहान्विता मतिः॥
en: Grieved at my departure, you have come far away. Go back. heart be affectionately directed towards the relatives whom we leave behind as our pledges to you.

sa: सोऽसुरान् दर्शनादेव शक्तो हन्तुं सहानुगान्। निवातकवचान् सर्वान् नागानिव महाह्रदे॥
en: Like the snakes in a great lake he (Krishna) is capable of destroying at the very first sight all those Asuras, the Nivatkavachas, with all their followers.
